text:
Introduce the two models. The transparent baseline maps prior ten-year recurrence to expected next-year burned share. The nine-feature two-part regression first estimates whether burning occurs, then estimates burned share when burning occurs. On the frozen final test, it lowered all-row MAE and improved ranking capture, while RMSE was similar and the high-burn 2025 outcome was underpredicted.

[Sources]
reports/validation/model_final_decision.md; reports/figures/model_final_test_metric_comparison.png
